objects.name: The Well-Head
objects.vInscr: A thousand years of buckets. The rope is worn to a thread, and holds.

landmarks.name: The Bell of the Gathered
landmarks.inscription: Cast from the bones of those who would not come when it was rung. It is rung for them still.

landmarks.name: The Hand That Was Kept
landmarks.inscription: It blessed the first war and was cut off for it. They caged it rather than bury it, lest the earth be blessed as well.
